text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Owww... Now I've really gone and done
it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-but... if this is all it takes t'bring me
down, then
what was the point in even
com'n to the city?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I don't make my inj'ry any
worse, so
please lemme train!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But what if I fall way b'hind while I'm
rest'n?
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself.
Alright, let's do what we can right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've already got a whole heap of catch'n
up to
do...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...'Kay. But I'm gonna hold you to it.
choice_data_list: Get your strength back, and we'll take it back together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. What am I even doing here? I'm
not
dazzl'n in the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin trudges back to the dorm
looking
pained.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Time t'pep up and get back on track!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... ...Gotta endure!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Agh! Ow!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-but! I...
choice_data_list: I took this too lightly. Let's call it here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, fine. I don't wanna worry you,
after all...
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to cover for the delay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being such a good-for-noth'n...
Well, I'm
off t'get some rest...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A deeply frustrated Yukino Bijin takes
my words
to heart and heads back to
recuperate...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I have t'get closer—anything to make this gap smaller...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is about the best I can manage right
now...
But still...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I've gotta do what I can t'make sure
I can
catch up real quick once I recover!
choice_data_list: Better than being left behind, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin focuses on what she can do
in the
moment, and it gives us good
results!
